enchantments.tooltip: Feat: Wind Through The Trees: When enemies hit or miss you, they have a 5% chance to be knocked down with no save. This may only trigger once every 12 seconds, and shares a cooldown with the Wind through the Trees feat.
Immunity to Fear: The wearer of this item is immune to all fear effects.
Lamordia: Melancholic Slot (Accessory):Apply a Lamordia augment to this item.
Lamordia: Dolorous Slot (Accessory):Apply a Lamordia augment to this item.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
